items.title: Why Chalmers's budget will rein in the property free-for-all
items.description: After being rejected twice by an electorate that didn't want to give up lucrative tax arrangements on property, the Albanese government has sniffed the breeze and decided the time is ripe for change.

items.title: The Australians the treasurer has in mind as he targets home ownership
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers will hand down the federal budget tonight. It's expected to tackle housing inequity, but will it bring back the Great Australian Dream?

items.title: Could this be the 'most interesting' budget in decades? Here's what we know
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers is unveiling his fifth budget tonight, and housing for younger Australians will be a centrepiece.

items.title: Live: Chalmers says Labor has chosen 'hard road of reform' in federal budget
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says tonight's budget will be the government's most ambitious and will feature "more than the usual amount of savings and more than the usual amount of reform". Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: Australian soldier killed during parachuting training
items.description: An Australian army soldier has died during a parachuting training course at the Jervis Bay Airfield in New South Wales.

items.title: Live: More than 70 UK Labour MPs call for Sir Keir Starmer's resignation
items.description: At least four ministerial aides have stepped down and more than 70 UK Labour MPs have publicly called for Sir Keir Starmer's resignation. Follow live.

items.title: 'Relief' as Voss resigns as Carlton coach after torrid run of results
items.description: Michael Voss has left Carlton, resigning with immediate effect following a run of seven consecutive AFL defeats, with another former Carlton boss Mick Malthouse saying the Brisbane premiership-winning player will be relieved to be out of the hot seat.

items.title: Hantavirus ship travellers headed to Perth's COVID 'white elephant'
items.description: Nestled away in Perth's outer fringes, this 500-bed facility was built during the COVID-19 pandemic as a quarantine centre but sat idle for years. Now, a different deadly virus will see it used for its intended purpose.

items.title: Shot fired in alleged armoured truck heist in Queensland town
items.description: Police arrest a man who allegedly stole a significant amount of money from a cash-in-transit vehicle while armed with a gun in Hervey Bay.

items.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire on 'life support', with energy woes to continue
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he's aiming for "complete victory" in Iran as the US and Iran reach an impasse in negotiations.

items.title: Delta 'proud' to be at Eurovision as five nations boycott competition
items.description: This week, the Eurovision Song Contest will burst onto the stage in Vienna, and onto screens around the globe, but behind the colour and campness, this year's competition is shaping up as one of the most politically charged in history.

items.title: Trump, Xi and the AI race that could reshape global power
items.description: When Trump last visited China in 2017, artificial intelligence was not yet the centre of global power. Now it is.

items.title: Breaking: Police search for alleged offender after man set on fire at apartment complex
items.description: Emergency service crews were called to an apartment complex in the Wollongong suburb of Warrawong overnight after a 25-year-old man was set on fire.

items.title: 'Didn't have the balls': Hume takes shot at Labor after shocking Coalition loss
items.description: Deputy Liberal leader Jane Hume is promising a new day for a Coalition that has lost its way, but whether the party can recover from the wreckage of Farrer remains to be seen.

items.title: More or less quiz: Follow the money and see what it gets you
items.description: A new quiz format? In this economy? Celebrate budget day with our More or Less challenge.

items.title: Inside the US blockbuster that brought $68 million to the Gold Coast
items.description: The $110 million Mortal Kombat sequel is the next in a laundry list of productions putting Queensland on the radar for international films.

items.title: The cost of the caring burden for single, childless women
items.description: Single women over 45 without children are much more likely to be spending time caring for family members who are aging, have a disability or chronic illness. And it's not just costing them financially.

items.title: The university where teaching is tougher than having terminal cancer for this academic
items.description: The University of Newcastle has been found to be worst in class when it comes to staff wellbeing. Now, an academic with terminal cancer is speaking out about it because others fear they cannot.

items.title: Domestic violence charges against long-serving Qld mayor dropped
items.description: The long-serving mayor of Lockhart River on eastern Cape York was facing seven domestic violence charges but the case against him won't proceed.

items.title: Vanuatu drops limitations on China in key pact with Australia
items.description: The ABC can reveal that after months of difficult negotiations, the Nakamal Agreement has been approved by Vanuatu's cabinet but omits key limitations on China's influence.

items.title: Gout springs relay surprise as U20 world champs team named
items.description: Gout Gout is set to take part in the 200m and 4x400m relay at the Under-20 World Athletics Championships in August.

items.title: Aussie female racing drivers star at home and abroad
items.description: Australia's strong cohort of young female racing drivers has shone at home and abroad, with a former F1 Academy driver achieving consecutive podiums on her Japanese debut and history made in the GT4 Australia.

items.title: Captain of virus-hit ship praises all aboard as Australians set to return home
items.description: The MV Hondius's captain has praised the patience and kindness of his crew and guests as they disembark.

items.title: Suspected death of triple killer cold comfort for grieving families
items.description: A family member of one of the victims of the Lake Cargelligo shootings says justice has not been served despite the discovery of a body believed to be that of Julian Ingram.

items.title: Darwin company's $50 million plan to make diesel from gas condensate
items.description: Global Resource Recovery NT says production of the  first diesel made from Central Australian gas condensate will leave Darwin in July.
